job: Inspect the facility clearly and move independently through its aisles
direction: Quiet industrial control console; warm scene materials, mint movement controls, amber equipment
observations: Existing orbit controls cannot move a user independently along an aisle.
Existing full-height walls and overhead structure obscure the overview.
Existing camera settings are limited to quality and fixed viewpoints.
constraints: Walking is independent of robot movement and works in local demo mode.
WASD and arrow keys only control the camera while the scene owns focus.
Camera movement cannot cross blocked navigation cells, including during slow frames.
Pointer lock is optional; dragging and touch controls remain available.
Escape releases mouse capture without collapsing the viewport.
Mode changes, window blur and hidden tabs clear held movement input.
Minimap and saved destinations resolve to valid ground-floor aisle positions.
Reduced-motion mode has no automatic camera rotation or movement easing.
All controls have labels, visible keyboard focus and touch-friendly targets.
No additional runtime dependencies or changes to simulation geometry.
